scope: Prepare a high-frame video-reference rebuild for Yoyo digSand only.
characterContract: Yoyo is a human little girl and companion, never a dog, puppy, mascot animal, or generic pet.
Use the clean-2d Yoyo identity: black straight bangs, small top bun, childlike proportions, soft friendly face, navy-and-red outfit language.
The action must read as entering and exiting the ground through contact, occlusion, and body weight, not as a sticker floating over dust.
Keep full-body readability at the start and end; mid-action partial cover is allowed only when the authored foreground ground lip physically hides the lower body.
Avoid half-body-only references, floating busts, pasted faces, paw marks, collars, pet beds, pet bowls, animal semantics, and disconnected dust clouds.

promptFocus: Full-body Yoyo crouches on a small soft indoor floor patch, presses both hands to the ground, and the floor opens into a rounded soil lip touching her feet.
Yoyo sinks downward with visible body weight: knees bend, shoulders lower, hair bun follows the vertical motion, and the ground lip overlaps the legs in front.
At the hidden midpoint, only a physically justified small top-of-head or hand hint may appear, surrounded by attached dirt rim and tiny dust puffs that touch the hole.
Yoyo pops back out through the same hole, hands push on the ground rim, then she returns to a stable full-body standing pose.
No animal digging, no paws, no pet tunnel, no floating half-body bust, no detached dust clouds.

phasePlan.phase: full-body crouch, both feet on ground
hands touch ground, first attached dust
lower legs pass behind foreground ground lip
brief hidden beat, small top hint only if needed
head and hands emerge through same rim
full body pushes out, feet reconnect

extraction.frameSelection: Extract 24 evenly spaced reference frames at 12fps, then select 8 runtime keyframes matching the phase plan for the fixed 8-column Yoyo atlas.

layers.description: Rounded soil/floor rim in front of Yoyo's legs during sink and emerge frames; this is the only reason partial body cover is allowed.
Human full-body Yoyo with stable scale and vertical weight shift through the whole action.
Small hard-edged dust puffs touching the ground rim or hands; no detached floating clouds.

acceptanceGates: Frames 0 and 7 are full-body, grounded Yoyo poses.
Any middle-frame partial cover is caused by the same-frame foreground ground lip, not by cropping the source image.
The ground rim touches Yoyo's feet, hands, or body in every sink/emerge frame.
Yoyo keeps the same human little girl identity and never reads as a dog, pet, or animal digger.
Scale stays stable across all 8 runtime frames; the body moves through the ground instead of floating above it.
Dust and dirt effects are attached to the ground contact area and do not become loose detached particles.
The selected 8 runtime frames are 192x208 transparent PNGs and rebuild row 17 of assets/yoyo/spritesheet.webp.
nonGoals: Do not modify clone-heart, dharma-manifest, or their Pixi fullscreen timelines.
Do not create a full-room dig scene for the home view in this pass.
Do not replace Yoyo with a mascot, animal, or pet-like digging pose.
